{"main_point": "Michael Moore's upcoming documentary 'Sicko,' which criticizes the U.S. healthcare system by contrasting it with Cuba's model, has been leaked online and is under federal investigation for violating the Cuban embargo, while the film's release faces opposition from health insurance companies."}
{"base_author": ["Reports confirm Michael Moore's documentary 'Sicko' was leaked to peer-to-peer networks, marking a second pre-release leak in a month for Lionsgate Studios."]}
